name: Task 6: Referential Integrity Dimension - Cross-Table Foreign Key Enforcement
description:
[SILVER LAYER] [DIMENSION: Referential Integrity] [ACTION: QUARANTINE]
Verifies that orphaned FKs are isolated to Silver Quarantine:
- Student Institution_Code foreign key (e.g. STU006 'INST_NON_EXISTENT_999') -> STU_DQ_04.
- Enrollment Student_ID (ENR005 'STU_NON_EXISTENT_999') -> ENR_DQ_03.
- Enrollment Program_Code (ENR007 'PRG_INVALID_CODE_999') -> ENR_DQ_04.
- Enrollment Institution_Code (ENR015 'INST_UNKNOWN_999') -> ENR_DQ_05.
